items.t: Internal water pump leaks coolant into the oil
items.job: Replace internal water pump (timing cover removal), flush oil and coolant
items.note: Labor-guide times reported for this job run up to about 15 hours. If coolant has already damaged the bearings, the engine may need replacing instead.

items.t: AWD power transfer unit (PTU) overheats, leaks or fails
items.job: Replace PTU seals and fluid, or rebuild/replace the PTU
items.note: A seal-only repair is at the low end (RepairPal lists about $394-551 for the output shaft seal). A grinding PTU needs the bearing kit or a full unit.
